title: Finance Assistant
description:
Adecco are pleased to be recruiting for a Finance Assistant to work within the Lincolnshire Police Force

Location: Nettleham, Lincoln
Contract Type: Temporary
Working Pattern: Full Time, 37 hours per week, Monday to Friday
Hourly Rate: 12.83 per hour
End Date: October 2027

Our client is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Exchequer Assistant to join their Finance team. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the efficient management of financial transactions within the public sector. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in supporting the delivery of a high-quality exchequer service across the Authority.

Key Responsibilities:

As an Exchequer Assistant, your duties will include:
- Processing creditor invoices promptly and accurately to ensure timely payments.
- Investigating and resolving complex queries related to invoices by liaising with both internal and external contacts.
- Undertaking HQ Cashier duties and processing petty cash returns, ensuring all costs are appropriately documented.
- Issuing petty cash upon request and managing any returns in compliance with established procedures.
- Carrying out supplier statement reconciliations as required.
- Processing Purchase Orders and managing purchases where applicable.
- Facilitating the setup of new suppliers, making informed decisions, and coordinating with internal and external contacts.
- Managing firearms refunds and processing Boarding Up invoices, investigating each incident accordingly.
- Booking travel and hotel accommodations and addressing any related queries.
- Resolving exchequer-related inquiries promptly and courteously.
- Ensuring all exchequer processes adhere to predetermined timelines.
- Promoting best practises in exchequer matters across the organisation, providing training and guidance to personnel as needed.

Requirements:
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy in financial processing.
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Ability to work collaboratively within a team and provide exceptional support to colleagues and external partners.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.
- Familiarity with financial systems and processes is advantageous.

Why Choose This Role?

Join a dedicated Finance team committed to upholding the highest professional standards.
Be part of an organisation that values ethical conduct and diversity.
Contribute to meaningful work within the public sector, supporting the community and ensuring financial integrity.

Additional Information:

The duties outlined in this advertisement are not exhaustive. The successful candidate may be required to undertake additional responsibilities within the general scope of the role. The organisation promotes a culture of equality and diversity and is committed to safeguarding children and vulnerable adults.

If you are enthusiastic about making a difference in the finance sector and possess the skills required for this role, this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

For more information and to apply for the Exchequer Assistant position, please contact the recruitment agency today. Seize the chance to elevate your career while contributing to a vital public service!
